name: sensitivity
description: One-variable sensitivity analysis with sympy: exact function values, the symbolic derivative d f/dx, and the elasticity (d f/dx * x/f) at each sampled point in a table. Points where f=0 get an 'undefined' elasticity instead of a fake number; one-variable-at-a-time limits are stated.
route: sensitivity analysis of f(x) = 30*x - 1000, x from 10 to 50 step 5, sensitivity of profit = -2*q**2 + 400*q - 5000, q from 50 to 150 step 10
